howto.name: Upload a PNG
howto.text: Drop a .png file up to 500 MB.

howto.name: PrivaTools converts via Pillow
howto.text: Both formats are lossless, so the conversion is faithful and the alpha channel survives.

howto.name: Convert and download
howto.text: Click Convert. Both formats are lossless, so this is a faithful conversion, and TIFF keeps the alpha channel — the right choice for archival and print pipelines that will not take PNG.

faq.q: Is PNG transparency preserved in the TIFF?
faq.a: Alpha transparency is preserved where the target TIFF profile supports it. For print/archival TIFF without an alpha channel, transparent areas are flattened to white.
TIFF is the standard for print prepress, scanning, and long-term archival. PNG→TIFF is lossless, so no image detail is lost in the conversion.

faq.q: Are my images uploaded to a third party?
faq.a: No. Processing is local to the PrivaTools backend; files are temporary and removed right after download.
